usage_rules: Use these raw M5 BID OHLC files as the common immutable price cache for future strategy tests.
Do not refetch or silently substitute another vendor when comparing strategies unless a new dataset version is explicitly created.
For 10m, aggregate only exactly two contiguous M5 children at bucket t and t+5m; reject incomplete buckets.
Record strategy-specific spread/commission/slippage separately; cached OHLC contains no execution-cost model.
US500/NAS100 are Dukascopy index CFDs; US stocks are Dukascopy stock CFDs.
